info.title: Agent
info.description: Agents are the customer service executives in your organization. They are the primary users of the help desk software and use it to interact with contacts and resolve tickets.

get.description: Retrieves the preferences of the currently logged-in agent.

patch.description: Updates the preferences of the currently logged-in agent.

post.description:
Sets the profile photo for the currently logged-in agent.

Note: To upload the photo, generate an OAuth token for the scope Desk.basic.UPDATE, profile.userphoto.UPDATE.

userPhoto.description: Photo file to upload as the agent profile picture

post.description: Schedules reassignment of tickets, tasks, and automations belonging to a deleted or deactivated agent to another agent within the same department.

get.description: Retrieves details of agents for the specified agent IDs.

parameters.name: agentIds
parameters.description:
Comma-separated array of agent IDs.

Note: The maximum number of IDs allowed is 50.

get.description:
Retrieves the profile photo for the specified agent.

Note: To get the agent photo, generate an OAuth token for the scope Desk.agents.READ,profile.userphoto.READ or Desk.basic.READ,profile.userphoto.READ.

parameters.name: fileSize
parameters.description:
Size of the image file to download

Possible values: THUMBNAIL, ACTUAL

post.description: Activates agents in your help desk.
Removes the identification details of a deleted agent.

get.description: Retrieves a particular number of agents based on the specified limit, with pagination support.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description:
Secondary information related to agents

Possible values: profile, role

schema.description: Secondary information related to agents, The allowed values are profile, role. You can include all two values by separating them with commas in the API request.

parameters.name: roleIds
parameters.description:
Comma-separated array of role IDs

Note: The maximum number of IDs allowed is 50.

parameters.name: searchStr
parameters.description: Searches agents by first name, last name, or email ID

parameters.name: cfSearchStr
parameters.description: Searches agents by custom field

parameters.name: cfFieldName
parameters.description: API name of the custom field used for searching and listing agents

parameters.name: fieldName
parameters.description:
Field used for searching and listing agents

Possible values: firstName, lastName, name, emailId

parameters.name: isLightAgent
parameters.description:
Indicates whether light or non-light agents must be returned

Possible values: true = light agents, false = non-light agents

parameters.name: sortOrder
parameters.description:
Sorts the list of agents

Possible values: asc, desc

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of agents to fetch; default value is 10 and maximum value is 200

schema.description: Number of agents to fetch. The default value is 10 and the maximum value supported is 200.

parameters.name: rolePermissionType
parameters.description:
Filters agents by role and permission type

Possible values: AgentPublic, AgentPersonal, AgentTeamPersonal, Admin, Light, Custom, ${NON_LIGHT}

parameters.name: profileIds
parameters.description:
Comma-separated array of profile IDs

Note: The maximum number of IDs allowed is 50.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Index number, starting from which the deleted agents must be fetched

schema.description: Index number, starting from which the agents must be fetched

parameters.name: isConfirmed
parameters.description: Filters Confirmed & Unconfirmed agents

schema.description: Key that denotes if the agents must be confirmed or unconfirmed.

parameters.name: departmentIds
parameters.description:
Comma-separated array of department IDs

Note: The maximum number of IDs allowed is 50.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description:
Filters agents by activation status

Possible values: ACTIVE, DISABLED, DELETED, IMPORTED

schema.description: Key that filters agents based on their activation status: ACTIVE, DISABLED, DELETED or IMPORTED

post.description:
Creates an agent in your help desk.

Note: The emailId, lastName, associatedDepartmentIds, and rolePermissionType fields are mandatory in the request. To assign the profile and role for the agent, pass one of the supported rolePermissionType values from the source documentation.
